messages:
alex_customer: Hey team — trying to apply a 50% promo code on a new account but it fails at checkout. Account shows currency=CAD and there's HST on the invoice. Promo says 'eligible for accounts in USD/EUR only' but the UI suggested it should work. Error: 'PROMO_NOT_APPLICABLE_REGION'. Anyone seen this?

emma_support: Sorry about that, Alex. Can you DM the account ID or paste it here? Also, which SKU/plan were you trying to apply the promo to?

alex_customer: acct_6Yx9ZN. Plan: hosted-usage (pay-as-you-go tokens). Example call I made:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/claim_promo
{
  "account_id": "acct_6Yx9ZN",
  "promo_code": "SUMMER50",
  "currency": "CAD"
}
```
Response: `{ "error": "PROMO_NOT_APPLICABLE_REGION", "eligible_regions": ["US","EU"] }`

emma_support: thx. escalating to billing. @raj_billing can you take a look?

raj_billing: looking. quick notes: our promo engine currently validates promo by billing_currency and tax_region. Some promos were configured as USD/EUR-only due to previous tax handling simplification. But SUMMER50 was meant to be global. I see the promo metadata missing CA in allowed_regions.

raj_billing: also worth noting: for Canadian customers we compute tax (HST/GST/PST) at checkout. Our promo eligibility check uses total_after_tax < threshold for some vouchers — that causes weird rejections when tax pushes final total slightly above allowed cap.

alex_customer: so it's blocked because of HST amount? That seems wrong — promo should apply to the pre-tax subtotal.

dena_engineer: pinged eng infra. Short-term: we can either expand allowed_regions to include CA and change validation to pre-tax subtotal. Long-term: promo engine needs to be explicit about base_amount vs gross_amount and locale tax rules.

promo-bot: [system] created internal case BC-7832 referencing acct_6Yx9ZN and promo SUMMER50

emma_support: For immediate customer unblock, I can grant manual credit to offset the tax delta. Alex, want a one-time credit now while we fix the promo rule?

alex_customer: yes please — that would unblock us. Also curious why the UI suggested it should work though.

raj_billing: UI bug: promo picker checks only promo.active & promo.visible flags client-side, not region. So the client shows it but server rejects. We'll file a quick fix to hide ineligible promos.

dena_engineer: REPRO steps for eng:
1) Create account with currency=CAD and region=CA/HST
2) Attempt to apply SUMMER50 to a small order where subtotal=9.99 USD-equivalent
3) Note server returns PROMO_NOT_APPLICABLE_REGION when tax pushes gross > promo_cap

dena_engineer: Investigated the promo code rule set: field `eligible_regions` is ["US","EU"]. The validation pipeline checks gross_amount_after_tax <= promo.max_applicable_amount. We should change to compare subtotal_before_tax. Will open PR to modify pipeline and add unit tests.

raj_billing: Plan: (a) immediate: add CA to eligible_regions for SUMMER50 and grant manual credit to alex on acct_6Yx9ZN (done pending approval), (b) medium: change server-side validation to use pre-tax amount and update promo schema to include explicit "apply_on": ["subtotal","gross"], (c) short UI fix: hide promos server-side returned as ineligible to avoid confusion.

emma_support: Alex — granted a one-time billing credit of CAD 5.00 to cover the tax gap, should reflect in your account within 10 minutes. Sorry again. :pray:

alex_customer: thanks, I see the credit applied. Appreciate the quick help.

promo-bot: [system] BC-7832 status updated to 'in_progress' assigned to dena_engineer

dena_engineer: opened PR #1198 to change validation to use subtotal_before_tax + new promo flag. Also added unit tests to cover CA HST/PST combos. Hoping for review today.

raj_billing: filing follow-up to ensure reporting shows promo redemptions by pre/post-tax amount — finance wants clarity for tax reporting.

emma_support: closing loop — Alex, I'll check back once PR is merged and we push a patch so SUMMER50 behaves as intended globally. Anything else I can do now?

alex_customer: all good for now. would like a note on the account saying the promo should be valid for future purchases.

emma_support: noted on acct_6Yx9ZN. I'll add a comment and CC billing team.

promo-bot: [system] BC-7832 comment: 'manual credit applied; awaiting promo engine fix'

dena_engineer: FYI QA will run tests across CA provinces (ON/QC/BC) to check HST/GST/PST variants — might catch other edge cases.

raj_billing: thanks team. tagging finance for visibility. @emma_support please mark resolved once PR is in prod. :white_check_mark:
